{{unknown name}} [[File:Gym Badge Thieves.png|250px|thumb|The Gym Badge thieves]] The '''Gym Badge thieves''' are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HS05|The Blue Badge of Courage]]''. They are known traveling throughout the [[region]]s of the [[Pokémon world]], stealing [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s so they don't have to work hard for them, and they sometimes sell them to make some money. As {{an|Misty}}, {{Tracey}}, and [[Sakura]] were visiting the Badge maker [[Kinso]] in [[Rifure Village]], the thieves stole the Badges the trio had been working on. Fortunately, Sakura's {{p|Beautifly}} tracked down the thieves. After being defeated, they returned the Badges and quickly ran away, vowing to never steal any more Gym Badges ever again. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gym Badge thieves |pkmn=Zigzagoon |type1=Normal |img=Badge Thieves Zigzagoon.png |epnum=HS05 |epname=The Blue Badge of Courage |desc={{p|Zigzagoon}} was seen briefly battling, and then losing, to [[Sakura's Espeon]] and [[Misty's Psyduck]] after the thieves were tracked down for stealing the Gym Badges.
